description:
Are you an ambitious, self-motivated professional looking to launch a rewarding career in industrial B2B sales?
We are seeking a dynamic Junior Sales Representative to join our team. In this role, you will focus on selling high-quality refractory materials to industrial clients.
You do not need a long track record in the industry to apply. If you have the right attitude, excellent communication skills, and a hunger to learn, we will train you from the ground up.
This is a 100% home office (work-from-home) position, offering you the flexibility to manage your daily routine while driving business growth.
Mentorship & Training:
You won't be doing this alone. From day one, you will receive direct, hands-on mentorship and comprehensive training from the foreign Chief of our Representative Office. You will learn everything about our specialized product line, sales techniques, and market navigation from a 30 year industry expert.
Key Responsibilities:
* Identify and reach out to potential industrial clients (iron casting foundries, steel casting foundries, and aluminium industry plants) to introduce our refractory solutions.
* Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with new and existing customers.
* Conduct online presentations, handle inquiries, and prepare commercial offers.
* Collaborate closely with the Chief of the Representative Office to meet sales targets and execute market strategies.
* Manage your daily sales activities independently from your home office.
requirements_text:
What We Are Looking For:
* A "Young" Professional Mindset: Energetic, tech-savvy, adaptable, and eager to learn a highly specialized technical trade.
* Experience: No extensive experience is required. Prior experience in sales in the industrial sector, especially metallurgical, ferrous or non ferrous industrial plants, with an strong drive to succeed working for an European company is more important.
* Self-Discipline: Proven ability to work independently, manage your time effectively, and stay motivated in a remote work environment.
* Communication: Good verbal English skills, together with Vietnamese verbal and written communication skills; ability to confidently speak with business clients, purchasing and plant managers.
* Education: A degree or background in Engineering, Materials Science, Ceramics is a plus, but not mandatory.
* Submit your CV in English.
